picker.intro: Import your collection from Mylar3 or Kapowarr. Both store the same series ids BackIssue uses, so every series maps exactly — monitored/paused state carries over, nothing is downloaded automatically, and re-running is safe (already-added series are skipped). Files on disk are picked up by the normal library scan afterwards.
picker.uploadNote: Mylar3: mylar.db · Kapowarr: Kapowarr.db (stop the other app first, or upload a copy).
picker.path: …or a path this server can read
picker.pathNote: e.g. a folder mounted into the container.

preview.found: Found a {app} library: {total} series ({fresh} new, {existing} already here).

run.importing: Importing… each series is fetched from the metadata source, so a big library takes a while. You can close this — the import keeps running.

done.failuresNote: Failures are usually the metadata source’s rate limit — re-run the migration later; imported series are skipped automatically.
done.next: Next: run System → Tools → Scan entire library so files on disk attach to the imported series.
